summary: Levetiracetam row is mostly supportable, but it needs updates: replace DailyMed black-box/source wording with FDA/openFDA, fix unsupported behavioral adverse-event percentages, remove the incorrect Inducer and IM formulation filters, add PubMed search aliases, and account for missing placebo-controlled RCT evidence, especially Levisohn2009 and Noachtar2008. Current cited RR50/MPC/seizure-freedom arithmetic is largely correct, but including Levisohn2009 changes the MPC maximum to 65.0% and seizure-freedom maximum to 38.1%.
